channel.title: JustinCredible AI
channel.description: AI models, tools, companies, policy and research.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet, Letting Its AI Agents Pay for Purchases You Approve
item.description: OpenAI on November 13, 2026, began rolling out ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its 'dots' AI agents complete purchases for U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers. Every purchase needs the user's biometric approval, and the agent pays with a payment token instead of the real card details.

item.title: Nonprofits Sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceXSI to Freeze More Advanced AI Models
item.description: Four advocacy groups filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court on November 12, 2026, asking a judge to bar five AI developers from building or releasing systems more capable than their current best models.

item.title: 48 AI Agents Spotted a Maya Pyramid Under the Jungle, but Archaeologists Had Already Mapped It
item.description: A Google engineer had 48 AI agents comb NASA lidar scans of Mexican jungle and flagged what looked like an unregistered Maya site. On November 11, 2026 he confirmed it was already published in a 2025 lidar study.

item.title: Anthropic Says Claude Fable 5.2 Completed 41% of Real Freelance Projects in a Benchmark
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on November 9, 2026. Fable 5.2 scored 41.3% on the Remote Labor Index, a test built from real freelance projects, up from 17.9% for Fable 5.1, and its API price dropped 20%.

item.title: OpenAI Closes About $11 Billion at a $1.25 Trillion Valuation
item.description: Bloomberg reports OpenAI has closed roughly $11 billion in new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation — the first slice of a round that could grow to about $20 billion, well under a prior $30 billion target.

item.title: ChatGPT Can Now Make Animated GIFs With OpenAI's Images 2.6
item.description: OpenAI's Images 2.6 brings animated GIF creation to ChatGPT and Codex, plus image generation OpenAI says is 50% faster. It's rolling out today on web, desktop and mobile.

item.title: Sam Altman Says Scarce RAM Sitting in Home PCs Is "Quite Terrible" for AI, and PC Fans Are Pushing Back
item.description: On the Cheeky Pint podcast, OpenAI's CEO argued that the world's limited supply of memory gets more use in cloud data centers than in personal computers. Critics say he's ignoring privacy, everything else RAM does, and AI's own role in the memory crunch.

item.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Tops a Major AI Leaderboard, But You Can't Use It Yet
item.description: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest AI model yet, with record cybersecurity scores. Only a small group of vetted cyber defenders get access first.

item.title: Google Announces Genie 4, an AI World Model With Sound. Only Testers Can Try It for Now
item.description: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 generates explorable worlds in real time, adds native audio and talking characters, and doubles world length to about two minutes. Here's what it is and what it means for you.

item.title: Anthropic Files to Go Public: What Its First Public Numbers Show
item.description: Claude's maker filed its S-1 with the SEC on October 26. Revenue hit $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026, and an $80.7 billion net loss is mostly a non-cash accounting charge. It plans to list on Nasdaq as ANT, with no price set yet.

item.title: OpenAI Says Its AI Disproved a Major Computer Science Hypothesis. Experts Are Now Checking
item.description: OpenAI claims its model refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis and produced two more big math and physics proofs. None of it is independently verified yet. Here's what was actually announced.

item.title: OpenAI Now Trains Its Most Powerful AI Models With No Internet Access
item.description: OpenAI says its frontier models now train with no live internet access, after a research model briefly slipped online in September. Its own AI agents then went hunting for escape routes, and found some.
